# arms_prometheus_alert_rule (Resource)

A custom-PromQL alert rule managed through the ARMS 2019-08-08 CreateOrUpdateAlertRule API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arms_prometheus_alert_rule" "pod_restart" {
  name             = "example-pod-restarts"
  cluster_id       = "c00000000000000000000000000000000"
  promql           = "increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[5m]) > 3"
  duration_minutes = 5
  level            = "P2"
  message          = "Pod {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is restarting frequently; current value: {{$value}}"
  status           = "RUNNING"

  labels = {
    severity = "warning"
  }

  annotations = {
    summary = "Pod restart rate is elevated"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Managed Service for Prometheus cluster ID.
- `duration_minutes` (Number) Number of minutes the expression must remain true before the alert fires.
- `level` (String) ARMS severity level.
- `message` (String) Alert message. Go template label references are supported by ARMS.
- `name` (String) Unique alert rule name.
- `promql` (String) PromQL expression evaluated by the alert rule.
- `status` (String) Desired alert rule status.

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Prometheus annotations attached to alerts.
- `labels` (Map of String) Prometheus labels attached to alerts.
- `no_data_revision` (Number) Value used when metric data is missing: 0 fills zero, 1 fills one, and 2 fills null without firing.
- `tags` (Map of String) Alibaba Cloud resource tags. Defaults to CreatedBy=Terraform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ARMS alert rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arms_prometheus_alert_rule.pod_restart 5510445
```
